title: Multi-stage builds
statement: A Dockerfile has three stages: `FROM golang:1.23 AS build`, `FROM node:22-slim AS docs` and a last stage `FROM gcr.io/distroless/static` that does `COPY --from=build /out/app /app`. It is built with BuildKit (the default builder). Pick every one that applies.
choices: `docker build .` produces an image from the last stage; it contains no files from build except those copied with COPY --from
`docker build --target build .` stops after the build stage and produces that stage as the image
The docs stage is built too, because every stage in a Dockerfile always runs
COPY --from can also copy from an image that is not a stage, e.g. COPY --from=nginx:1.27 /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /nginx.conf
